snippet.title: Pitchside Empire - Build it. Book it. Own the pitch.
snippet.description:
Coming soon..
Start with one five-a-side pitch. Answer the phone, haggle over the price,
fill the hours. 
Reinvest: more pitches, more land, more staff. Grow enough and the neighbourhood league plays its season on your grass.
